narrative: On the almanack. The penny almanac open on the table at the lodging. A tied quire sits beside it. No price is written on the quire. On the almanack. The quire is on the table, still tied. He does not write a sum.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read "St George" and left the quire unpriced.

entities.name: the quire
entities.context: Shown on almanac in St George, and the quire already in
